name: Scarlet
source:
One of three Daughters of the Coffin, immortals created by Lilith.

[spoiler]During the battle between the Count and Toshirou, she is revealed to be Mikage reincarnation. She is later killed while protecting Toshirou. Her soul later reunited with Toshirou after he died.[/spoiler]
